beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Attention, distribution, trust, and credible differentiation remain harder to reproduce than another feature.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Founders may therefore face more output pressure without gaining equivalent security or bargaining power.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The attention chapters connect that pressure to permanent public demonstrations of competence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This is the argument’s bridge from technological optimism to the need for institutional change.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its concern is what the new capacity amplifies, not whether useful AI tools exist.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The constructive turn begins by refusing to treat collaboration as an inspirational slogan.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Shared work requires visible contributions, responsibilities, rewards, enforcement, and ways to resolve disagreement.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Invisible maintenance and scarce credit can undermine cooperation even among people with compatible aims.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A shared project needs to know who controls its name, assets, and treasury.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It also needs an answer for the participant who wants to leave.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book treats these questions as practical architecture rather than administrative details added later.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That makes its alternative more demanding than simply inviting founders into another community.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The next chapter expands entrepreneurship from creating a company to creating durable coordination.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Schools, laboratories, professional networks, and shared standards illustrate that broader possibility.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An institution creator builds conditions in which many useful operators can work.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Trust, continuity, and the memory of contribution become resources that need not restart each time.
